[[File:Max_Rebo_Corurcant_Nights.png|thumb|right|180px|"Max Reebo" - "Coruscant Nights"]]
'''Coruscant Nights''' was a source of entertainment on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The [[Musician/Legends|musician]] [[Max Rebo/Legends|Max Rebo]] was part of it. Posters were put up around [[Galactic City/Legends|the city]] in order to promote Coruscant Nights. [[Max Reebo – Coruscant Nights/Legends|One design]] showed white text on a dark background and read "Max Reebo ''[sic]''" - "Coruscant Nights". [[Coruscant Nights (poster)/Legends|Another]] showed the silhouette of two people against a blue background and said "Coruscant Nights" at the top<ref name="Lethal">{{TCW|Lethal Trackdown}}</ref> and "[[Coruscant Ballroom/Legends|Coruscant Ballroom]]" at the bottom.<ref name="Lethal Trackdown">In "[[Lethal Trackdown]]," the [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] text "[[Coruscant Ballroom/Legends|Coruscant Ballroom]]" can be read at the bottom of a copy of the ''second'' [[Painting/Legends|poster]], glimpsed over the entrance to [[Moshi Bar/Legends|Moshi Bar]] as [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] says, "You may be surprised what people reveal when they have been drinking." If you compare the design at bottom of this poster to the full poster seen ''inside'' the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] (where only the "Coruscant Nights" parts can be deciphered), you can see that it is the same poster, meaning that it reads "Coruscant Nights" at the top and "Coruscant Ballroom" at the bottom. The full version of the poster ''over the cantina entrance'' can also be seen in the wide shot of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] leaving the bar, but only from a distance.</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
It is not known what exactly Coruscant Nights is, though the involvement of [[Max Rebo/Legends|Max Rebo]] suggests that it may be a series of concerts or a festival of some sort.

The two posters are first seen in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' episode ''[[Lightsaber Lost]]'', inside the building where [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] goes to fetch the criminal [[Car Affa/Legends|Car Affa]]. Only parts of the Max Rebo poster is seen in this episode, and the other poster is unreadable. Both posters are seen up close in [[Moshi Bar/Legends|Moshi Bar]] in in ''[[Lethal Trackdown]]''. The second version can also be seen on the streets of Coruscant in ''[[Evil Plans]]'', when [[IG-86 sentinel droid/Legends|IG-86]] is searching for [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]]. A mirror-inverted, and partially obscured, version of the Max Rebo poster can be seen in in an [[Unidentified Coruscant cantina/Legends|unidentified cantina]] in ''[[Pursuit of Peace]]''.
